cues: And why a high equivalent weight?
To make the same solution, a substance with a bigger equivalent weight must be weighed out in a bigger mass.
Two hundred fifty cubic centimetres of decinormal oxalic acid needs one point five seven five grams.
The same with Mohr's salt needs nine point eight grams.
